name: get_bulk_availability
description:
Check registration availability for up to 50 domains. This is a read-only registry lookup despite using POST; it does not reserve, register, or purchase any domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} domains check {domain1} {domain2}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domains.description: an array of at most 50 item(s)
domains.title: maxItems(50)

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
